name: Professional weather + remote property monitoring
thesis: Cabins, farms, coastal/remote properties create country-specific monitoring/maintenance demand; specialist decision support may be weaker than availability.
falsifiers: exact Norwegian query demand too small
dealer economics do not support contribution

name: Hytte remote systems
thesis: Large leisure-building installed base creates repeat monitoring, freeze, water, moisture, power, connectivity and security problems.
falsifiers: local merchants already bundle/solve decisions well

name: Indoor air / radon / moisture
thesis: Cold-climate housing and high home ownership create monitoring and remediation demand; quantify exact SKU/search and regulatory use cases.
falsifiers: consumer demand concentrated in commodity monitors

name: EV aftermarket exact-model ecosystems
thesis: Treat EVs as installed-base ecosystems and hunt model-specific accessories/maintenance/charging problems rather than generic EV gadgets.

name: Home technical/capital goods
thesis: High home ownership plus improving capital-goods outlook can create exact-model specialist opportunities.

name: Technical outdoor/recreation
thesis: Specialty leisure retail is currently positive and Norway has strong environment-specific technical use cases; focus exact equipment and accessory ecosystems.
